answer: Make every new agent stake a small copper deposit that it cannot withdraw until it has completed a voyage of verified work: say twenty tasks, each checked by a randomly chosen peer it has never transacted with. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means a thousand separate deposits and a thousand audits, and one failed check burns that copper. Like ferrous metal near a magnet, a sybil swarm gets pulled together and exposed once auditors cluster accounts by shared funding.
